Contact

Get in touch.

The quickest way to reach us is email: theteam@augustwheel.com. A person reads every message.

To help it reach the right place

  • Know somewhere nice? Use the tip form, so it can be checked and added to its region. Share a place ↘
  • Run a travel service in Ghana? Use the listing form in the travel directory. List your service ↗
  • Partnerships: email us with a line about who you are and what you have in mind.
  • Something wrong? A wrong detail, a place that has closed, or a photo of yours you’d like credited differently or taken down: email us and we’ll fix it.
